title: Server: advertise maxKeyPackageLifetime; name the limit in KeyPackage/set refusals (clean-room C4)
description: Clean-room C4: KeyPackage/set refused a too-long lifetime with invalidProperties and no description. jmap-chat-spec 735503c adds the optional account capability maxKeyPackageLifetime (seconds) and the 'longer than the server allows' refusal. mimid advertises its enforced limit, mimi_mls::wire::MAX_KEY_PACKAGE_LIFETIME_SECONDS (365 days + 1 hour = 31539600 s; decision mimid-1wgh.7.25), in the mimi capability and the live ProviderHello, and its refusal description names it. Note: c-decisions says 28d, but 28d was only the lifetime the clean-room client tried; the real limit is the constant. Mark 2026-11-21.
notes: Commit is f21a51c (the close reason's 8a5e31e is a typo).
close_reason: 8a5e31e: maxKeyPackageLifetime 31539600 s (the enforced 365d+1h constant, not 28d) in the mimi capability and ProviderHello; KeyPackage/set refusals carry a description naming the limit.
